description: Displayed in the false code 20+05, restored by the Starfighter Staffel Memmingen at the Allgäu Airport (International F-104 Society; 916-starfighter German fate list, 2025). The association's own website also refers to F-104G 22+58, which other sources place at Motorworld Böblingen; which airframe stands in the shelter needs on-site confirmation.

Named type of the former JaboG 34; no serial published by the association. Fliegergeschichtliches Museum in a shelter at the former Memmingerberg air base, now Allgäu Airport; open Mondays 16:00-18:00, free admission.
